q1.sampleAnswer:
Hi Bailey,
I’m so happy to see you next week. How are things going? I hope you’re fine.
After reading the options to doing after seeing the exhibition, I prefer making a model of rocket. It could be exciting. But if you want trying on some space suits, I’ll enjoy it either.
About what question asking the astronaut, I think a good question to him could be, how many years has he studied to arrive there. And what he feels at the space.
I feel like having dinner with us, would you like to go to the Japanese restaurant?
Send my love to your family.
Take care,
Kike

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：回应邮件中的四条笔记：①表示自己也很高兴一起去太空博物馆（Me too!）；②告诉 Bailey 更想做火箭模型还是试穿宇航服（Tell Bailey）；③提出一个想问宇航员的问题（My question: …）；④感谢 Bailey 邀请自己参观后一起吃晚饭（Thank Bailey）
交际效果：文体和语气符合任务要求，能清楚表达观点并吸引读者
条理性：结构清晰、衔接连贯，使用多种连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的丰富性与准确性

anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果3/条理性3/语言3。内容切题，四个要点都有回应；开头结尾得体、整体语气友好，但前后不一致（Thank you to invite me to the dinner I will come.）；分段清楚但每段只有一句，关于宇航员的两段合并会更好，只用了 because, but, when 等基础连接词；词汇贴合话题（fly, fun, heavy），标点有疏漏，个别错误影响理解（I am always ask me how there can walk）。

q1.explanationZh: 满分邮件要逐一回应四条笔记：表示自己也很期待、说明更想做哪项活动、提出一个给宇航员的问题、感谢邀请并回复是否一起吃晚饭；用朋友之间友好的语气，约 100 词。

q2.sampleAnswer: Every time I have a chance I spend my time outdoors. Only time I don’t spend my time outdoors is when it is raining or snowing or if I am really exhausted. I think it is very important for people to spend their free time outdoors because it is good for health. When I am outdoor I like to walk in the nature or play football with my friend. There are all kinds of activities outdoor for people to enjoy, for example walking, riding bikes or playing football. Outdoor activites are good because people don’t need any money to have fun.

语言：词汇和语法结构的丰富性与准确性

q2.explanationZh: 满分文章要回答公告中的全部三个问题，并为观点给出理由和例子；开头要能吸引读者，语言生动，约 100 词。

q3.sampleAnswer: When Pat opened the book, an old letter fell out of it. Instantly she picked up the letter and started to read it. It was an old letter that her great grandfather had written to her great grandmother, he told her that missed her too much and that the days on Alaska were extremely cold and rainy. At this time Pat remembered when her grandfather told her the adventures of her great grandfather, Peter. His great grandfhater was a biologist and he had dedicated his life to investigate the flora and fauna of Alaska. When Pat finished to read the letter she smiled and keep the letter in the same place.

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：故事以给定的句子开头（When Pat opened the book, an old letter fell out of it.），情节与这封旧信相关且完整，有清楚的结局
交际效果：文体和语气符合任务要求，能清楚表达观点并吸引读者
条理性：结构清晰、衔接连贯，使用多种连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的丰富性与准确性

anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果5/条理性4/语言4。内容切题，紧接开头句，读者完全了解发生了什么；巧妙地在不同时间之间切换（写信的时候、祖父讲故事的时候），用 Pat 微笑暗示她读信后的感受；用 Instantly, At this time, When 标示时间，结构清楚；使用了 dedicated his life, flora and fauna 等较高级词汇，各种过去时态基本准确，错误（如 finished to read）不影响理解。
